children: Japanese stocks may fall amid geopolitical tensions that typically undermine appetite for risk assets. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Russian strikes hit energy infrastructure across his country hours after President Trump declared an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. Investors are closely monitoring developments between Russia and Ukraine and in the Middle East for their implications on crude oil prices. Nikkei futures are down 885 points at 68270 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.52 yen, compared with Y158.63 late Monday in New York. The Nikkei Stock Average closed little changed at 69030.92 last Friday. Japan's financial markets were closed for a public holiday on Monday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
